{{Top|leg}}
A '''Personnel Officer''' was a position used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They coordinated assignments at Alliance bases. [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Dara Gion]] served as [[Oracle Base]]'s Personnel Officer during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
